completionPolicy.requires: All visible required core/branch choices and required text fields

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l06.intro
elements.html:
Use examples to communicate format while noticing whose examples are missing.

An example can show a desired structure more clearly than a vague adjective. Keep facts separate from the example’s style: copying a format is not permission to invent matching facts. Examples also influence which voices and situations appear normal. If all examples represent one group, test whether the result works for others. A small classroom test can reveal a problem, but cannot prove a system is fair everywhere.

Practice scenario

A fictional club uses notices with headings “When / Where / Bring.” Every sample assumes participants own a laptop. This event provides paper and welcomes students without devices.

choices.text: The three headings, filled only with verified event facts.
The laptop requirement from old examples.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l06.format.feedback.shape
elements.html: Use structure while checking content.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l06.format.feedback.laptop
elements.html: That requirement does not apply here.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l06.format.feedback.names

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l06.include
elements.title: Which test addresses the missing perspective?

choices.text: Show it only to laptop owners.
Ask whether someone without a device can understand how to join.
Declare it fair because the layout is neat.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l06.include.feedback.same
elements.html: This repeats the blind spot.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l06.include.feedback.access
elements.html: Test the access condition the examples omitted.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l06.include.feedback.declare
elements.html: Appearance is not evidence of inclusion.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l06.transfer
elements.title: Rewrite one notice line so it includes students without devices. State one additional perspective your test did not cover.
elements.description: Practice text only. Saved on this device. Reviewed by you or an educator, not AI graded.

validators.text: Add enough reasoning to review (at least 30 characters).

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l06.rubric
elements.html:
Self-check

  • Preserves event facts.
  • Removes an unsupported device assumption.
  • Acknowledges a remaining test limitation.

Fairness has multiple definitions; this activity checks one access barrier, not universal fairness.
